title: Nested scalar tensor generators determine one module morphism
statement: For completed scalar extensions E to L to F on one integral tower module, equality of two module morphisms on all nested completed scalar tensor sections implies equality of the morphisms.

source.place: Proposition 3.5.1 and Stacks 0941; tensor-balancing and sheafification step

proof.text: Apply the underlying-sheaf tensor-induction substep to the two morphisms, then use sheaf morphism extensionality.
